assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Register local non-OAuth MCP server via POST /api/mcp/servers and inspect tool schema shape
steps.expected: Server registers; no-input tool parameters remain object-typed and open-object schema preserves additionalProperties
steps.observed: POST /api/mcp/servers returned 201 with requiresOAuth=False; schema check passed (noinputObject=True, openHasAdditionalProps=True).

steps.action: Invoke scheduled run using non-OAuth MCP server
steps.expected: Scheduled invocation is callable and not OAuth-gated for requiresOAuth=false server
steps.observed: POST /api/schedules/:id/run returned 500 with OAuth-consent-required error for round12-mcp001-eebd10; /api/mcp/tools entry was present but tools were empty immediately after registration.

assertions.issues: Fail: non-OAuth scheduled invocation path is still treated as OAuth-consent-required despite server creation reporting requiresOAuth=false.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Register pending-consent Arcade MCP server via POST /api/mcp/servers and inspect pre-consent /api/mcp/tools visibility
steps.expected: Server appears with discoverable tools pre-consent when contract requires visibility before consent
steps.observed: POST /api/mcp/servers returned 201 for round12-mcp004-eebd10; /api/mcp/tools entry existed but tools list was empty.

steps.action: Run scheduled invocation and inspect continuation metadata in run-result failure state
steps.expected: Failure response carries continuation metadata (authorization_url and/or llm_instructions) instead of opaque init failure
steps.observed: POST /api/schedules/:id/run returned 500 OAuth-consent-required with continuation fields absent (authorization_url, llm_instructions, continuationMetadata all missing).

assertions.issues: Fail: pre-consent tool discovery remained empty and scheduled failure responses still did not expose continuation metadata.

assertions.title: Model restrictions are enforced server-side across config, chat, agents, and assistants

steps.action: Restrict val-user model permissions and verify /api/models + /api/config surfaces
steps.expected: /api/models and /api/config expose filtered model access including filtered modelSpecs surface when applicable
steps.observed: /api/models was filtered to ['gpt-5.1']; /api/config returned modelSpecs present but empty list (count=0).

steps.action: Probe blocked-model attempts across chat, agent, and assistant surfaces
steps.expected: Blocked model attempts fail with model-access errors, not temporary-ban artifacts
steps.observed: Chat returned 403 Illegal model request; agent create returned 400 Illegal model request; assistant v2 create returned 400 Illegal model request; no temporary-ban responses in this run.

assertions.issues: Fail: blocked-model enforcement worked across chat/agent/assistant, but config modelSpecs list remained empty under restriction instead of presenting filtered modelSpecs content.

frictions.description: Immediately after MCP server creation, /api/mcp/tools showed server entries with empty tool lists for both non-OAuth and Arcade pending-consent probes.
frictions.resolution: Captured evidence and continued with scheduled-run checks.
